# Pinecrest Mountain Rentals — Summer Min-Stay & Instant-Book Rules

**Generated by: Bookings & Reservations skill**
**Effective:** Jun 1 – Sep 5, 2026 (peak summer season)
**Reservations lead:** Riley Okafor
**Channel manager:** Hostaway (rules pushed via API)
**Pricing engine:** PriceLabs

---

## Summary of Changes vs. Q2 (Spring) Rules

- **Weekend min-stay raised** for cabins and lakefront from 2 → 3 nights, in line with comp-set behavior.
- **Holiday lock** instituted for Jul 3–6 weekend (4-night min, all properties).
- **Instant-book turned ON for 18 properties** (was 14) — listing-rank investment for summer.
- **Length-of-stay discounts updated** — weekly 8% (was 10%), monthly 18% (was 25%) — tightened in line with peak-demand math.
- **Same-day-arrival window closed** at 5 PM (was 7 PM) for all summer bookings — gives Diego's team buffer.

---

## Min-Stay Rules (per segment, per season-block)

### Ski-In/Ski-Out Condos at Canyons Village (PC-01 to PC-08)

| Period | Weekend (Fri–Sun) | Weekday (Mon–Thu) | Holiday lock |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Jun 1 – Jun 30 (early summer) | 2 nights | 1 night | — |
| Jul 1 – Jul 7 (July 4 holiday) | 4 nights | 4 nights | Jul 3–6: 4-night min, all-week |
| Jul 8 – Aug 14 (peak summer) | 3 nights | 2 nights | — |
| Aug 15 – Sep 5 (back-to-school) | 2 nights | 1 night | — |

**Rationale:** Ski-in/out condos are summer-soft (about 35% lower demand than ski season). Holding min-stay loose maximizes occupancy. Studios (PC-03, PC-08) drop to 1-night weekday min throughout — they're our gap-night fillers.

### Mountain-Modern Cabins, Old Town & Deer Valley (PC-09 to PC-20)

| Period | Weekend (Fri–Sun) | Weekday (Mon–Thu) | Holiday lock |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Jun 1 – Jun 30 | 3 nights | 2 nights | — |
| Jul 1 – Jul 7 | 5 nights | 4 nights | Jul 3–6: 5-night min |
| Jul 8 – Aug 14 | 3 nights | 2 nights | — |
| Aug 15 – Sep 5 | 2 nights | 2 nights | — |

**Rationale:** Cabins are our peak-summer hero segment (groups, families, pet-friendly). 3-night weekend protects cleaning capacity (cabins have higher turnover cost). 5-night July 4 lock matches comp-set; we lost $14K in 2025 by booking 2-night July 4 stays that left orphan nights.

### Lakefront Properties — Jordanelle Reservoir (PC-21 to PC-24)

| Period | Weekend (Fri–Sun) | Weekday (Mon–Thu) | Holiday lock |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Jun 1 – Jun 21 (lake season opens May 23 but slow ramp) | 3 nights | 2 nights | — |
| Jun 22 – Sep 5 (peak lake season) | 4 nights | 3 nights | Jul 3–6: 5-night min |

**Rationale:** Lakefront is highest RevPAR; demand exceeds supply mid-summer. Tight min-stay is a revenue protector. 4-night weekend pushes Sun arrivals (a known under-booked night). 5-night July 4 mirrors what Vacasa, Evolve, and the local indie hosts are doing (comp-set scrape Apr 28).

---

## Length-of-Stay Discounts

| Discount | New (peak summer) | Old (Q2) | Applies to |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Weekly (7+ nights) | –8% | –10% | All segments |
| Monthly (28+ nights) | –18% | –25% | Cabins + condos only (not lakefront) |
| 14-night | (none) | –12% | Removed — too discount-heavy in peak |

**Rationale:** Peak summer demand doesn't need length-of-stay incentive. Last summer we gave away $9,400 in discount at 10% weekly for stays that would have booked at full rate. Tightening to 8% protects ADR. Removed monthly entirely on lakefront because demand sells out July–Aug — no need to discount.

## Instant-Book Rules

### Properties with Instant-Book ON (18 of 24)

| Property | Channel | Reason for ON |
|---|---|---|
| PC-01, PC-02, PC-05, PC-06, PC-07, PC-08 | Airbnb + VRBO | Strong Superhost listing rank; loose insurance fits ski-in/out condo guest profile |
| PC-09, PC-10, PC-12, PC-14, PC-16, PC-17, PC-18, PC-20 | Airbnb only | High demand; cabin guest profile screens better via instant-book + post-confirmation house rules acknowledgment |
| PC-19 | Airbnb + VRBO | Premium architecture cabin; high response rate boost from IB |
| PC-21, PC-22, PC-23 | Airbnb only | Lakefront; demand outstrips supply |

### Properties with Instant-Book OFF (6 of 24) — request-to-book only

| Property | Reason for OFF |
|---|---|
| PC-03 (Slopeside Studio) | Studio, hosts noisy guest types — pre-screen |
| PC-04 (Eagle's Perch) | Premium 4BR (sleeps 10); pre-screen for group composition + house rules acknowledgment |
| PC-11 (Bramble House) | Currently low-Superhost-rank; instant-book OFF until listing rewrite ships May 13 |
| PC-13 (The Foxglove) | Owner Anika Sharma requested manual review — sensitive about pet stays |
| PC-15 (The Tinder Box) | Old Town shared-wall property; HOA enforcement strict; party-risk flag |
| PC-24 (Lakeside Cottage) | New owner (Henrietta Bloom) — keeping IB off for first 90 days while we calibrate |

## Cancellation Policy by Segment

| Segment | Default cancellation policy | Premium cabins | Channel-specific |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ski-in/out condos | Firm (full refund 30 days out, 50% 7 days, 0% within 7) | — | Airbnb: Firm. VRBO: Firm. |
| Cabins | Firm | Strict 60 (PC-04, PC-10, PC-16) | Airbnb: Firm + Strict for 3 premium. VRBO: Strict 60 mirror. |
| Lakefront | Strict 60 (full refund 60 days out only) | — | Airbnb: Strict. VRBO: Strict 60. |

**Rationale:** Lakefront supply is inelastic in peak summer — once a Saturday night books, we can't recover it from a 2-week-out cancellation. Strict policy protects RevPAR. Cabin premium tier (4+ BR, sleeps 10+) carries the same logic.

---

## Same-Day Arrival Cutoff

| Property type | Cutoff (was) | Cutoff (now) | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| All properties | 7 PM | 5 PM | Diego's housekeeping team needs buffer for same-day flips on July 4 weekend; 5 PM cutoff means cleaner has finished + inspection complete by guest arrival |

**Implementation:** Hostaway "blocked check-in if booked < 6 hours from check-in time" rule, applied to all summer bookings.

| Holiday | Dates blocked | Min-stay applied |

| July 4 weekend (US peak) | Jul 3–6 | 4-night min (condos), 5-night (cabins + lake) |

## Channel-Specific Adjustments

### Airbnb
- Min-stay rules synced via Hostaway → Airbnb API (push frequency: every 60 min)
- Instant-book toggles synced same way
- "Smart Pricing" disabled on all 24 listings — PriceLabs is the source of truth

### VRBO
- Min-stay rules synced via Hostaway → VRBO API
- Instant-book ON for 7 properties (subset of Airbnb's 18 — VRBO IB has tighter listing-rank rules; we're conservative)
- Cancellation policy: Firm or Strict 60 (matches Airbnb)

### Direct (pinecrestmountain.com)
- Min-stay rules read from Hostaway via API (single source of truth)
- 14-day "instant book" effectively always on for direct (no friction)
- Cancellation policy 1 day looser than OTAs (full refund 14 days out for Firm tier) — modest direct-booking incentive
